verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI ships an official `crwl` CLI, documented at docs.crawl4ai.com/core/cli/. GitHub examples show AI-oriented use: markdown output (`-o markdown`), natural-language LLM extraction queries (`-q "Extract all product prices"`) and deep crawling (`--deep-crawl bfs --max-pages 10`). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and evidence of agent-friendly details such as structured JSON output and config/auth handling.
